audience: training teams that run courses, learners and assignments in EducateMe

useCases.title: Find learners behind on assignments
useCases.text: Find the course id, then list the assignments of the course with status and deadline. Read the submissions with their grades.

useCases.title: Review scores for a course
useCases.text: Read the score matrix of one course, with each learner's result per scored activity. Needs a key with workspace-admin scope.

useCases.title: Check scheduled webinars
useCases.text: List the activities of a course, then list its scheduled webinars for a date range, with join links.

useCases.title: Read the workspace activity log
useCases.text: Read recent enrollments, completions, invitations and attended events. Needs a key with workspace-admin scope.

useCases.title: Invite learners to courses
useCases.text: Invite a learner by email to one course, or to several courses at once. You can skip the email confirmation step.

useCases.title: Schedule a webinar for a course
useCases.text: Schedule webinar events for activities of a course, with start and end times in UTC.
